zoe: quick experiment idea: compact-rail deep links that open inline panes instead of full page. UX win for maintaining context but needs a solid URL contract.
mike: propose: keep canonical path + `?rail=compact&pane=usage#top` so share links still land on resource but reveal pane. e.g. `/console/projects/zenith?rail=compact&pane=usage#top`.
iris: accessibility: when pane opens programmatically we must move focus to the pane heading and announce it. Use `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="pane-title" aria-modal=false` for SR clarity.
dave: router concern: mixing query + hash can cause back/forward quirks. Consider `history.replaceState` for the initial reveal and `pushState` for user-driven navigation inside the pane.
zoe: hit on persistence: don't persist rail collapsed/expanded in global settings. session-only preference is safer. Otherwise users on other devices get surprising state.
mike: breadcrumbs: should include the pane label if open: `Console / Projects / Zenith / Usage`. Clicking it collapses the pane.
iris: keyboard flow: tab order should go into pane after reveal, pressing escape closes pane and returns focus to the originating control. Add a `data-origin-focus` attribute to store return target.
dave: perf: if page has heavy components, hydrate main content first but prefetch pane data if URL includes `pane=`. That balances TTFI with ownership data.
nav-bot: route-scan: pattern `/console/*/:id` with `pane` param appears in 3 modules. Suggest central handler `openInlinePane(urlParams)` to standardize lifecycle and analytics.
zoe: highlight behavior for shared links: if `?highlight=item42` present, show a subtle focus ring for 2.5s and set `aria-describedby` to note "Highlighted for share". Ensure color-contrast passes.
mike: add analytics event `nav.inline_pane_open` with props {resource, pane, highlight, via_deeplink}.
iris: QA list: SR narration check, keyboard-only path, color contrast on highlight, focus ring visible after JS focus.
dave: edge case: stale IDs -> show skeleton then run deferred open once resource resolves. Avoid scrolling prematurely.\e: (oops) dave: typo, ignore.
zoe: i'll draft the pattern doc: canonical URL examples, focus management snippets, replace vs push state guidance, skeleton + deferred open pattern, analytics schema. I'll post the PR for review later today.
mike: will review router code.
iris: will draft the accessibility checklist.
dave: I'll look at perf prefetch plan.
zoe: thanks all :raised_hands:
